Subject: Initial room block + quiet-floor request for Nov 30–Dec 2 exec retreat

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for holding space for our leadership offsite at Starlight Downtown. We're finalizing the room block and a few special requests and wanted to confirm options before we circulate the rooming form to attendees. Quick items: 

- Block: 32 rooms (26 king/double, 6 suites) for nights Nov 30–Dec 2.
- Quiet floors: we have a few neurodiverse attendees and one lactation/quiet-room need — can you hold floors 7 and 8 as quiet-designated?
- Suite upgrades: leadership would like to confirm upgrade pricing for two executive suites (for VP+), and the ability to convert one suite into a shared workstation space on Dec 1 afternoon.
- Early arrivals & shuttle: we may have 6 early arrivals landing Nov 30 between 8:30–11:00am and need a 6-person shuttle from the airport at 9:30am.

I'm attaching our initial block terms (attached: initial_block_terms.pdf) — can you confirm whether quiet-floor assignment and the shuttle are possible at the rates outlined? Also flag any blackout dates or attrition notes we should be aware of.

If helpful, Vivek is copied to confirm headcount and suite assignments. I'll follow up with a draft rooming manifest once we have the suite pricing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear note. Great to have you and the Redwood team returning to Starlight. Quick answers below and a couple of options: 

1) Quiet floors: We can reserve floors 7 and 8 as quiet-designated. We'll affix door hangers and instruct housekeeping for minimal mid-day noise. No additional fee for the designation.

2) Suite upgrades: We have two executive suites available at a negotiated upgrade of $125/night and one corner suite that we can convert to a workstation (we'll provide a long table + additional power strips). The conversion fee is a one-time $150 for the afternoon block.

3) Shuttle & early arrivals: 9:30am shuttle on Nov 30 is available; pickup will need an address for the airport arrivals curb. The shuttle vendor charges $220 flat for the transfer (round-trip optional).

4) Terms: I've attached the updated block terms (Starlight_block_terms_v2.pdf) — we revised attrition to 20% and added a late-arrival policy (rooms held until midnight without guarantee).

If you'd like, I can draft a rooming manifest template for you to populate and return. We can also send a DocuSign of these terms once you confirm suite pricing.

Best,
Elena Morales
Group Sales Manager
Starlight Hotels
